text:
Jana Morales: quick sync — we need clear acceptance gates for the onboarding sprint so eng + sales can sign customers up without extra support 
Mike Patel: agreed. are we keeping separate gates for latency, quality, and cost? 
Arjun Singh: yes — thinking triple-gate: perf, quality (evals), and compatibility (api/kv state) 
Selena V: +1. sales asked for a deterministic migration window too — customers want a clear deprecation notice and a rollback path 
Jana Morales: draft thresholds: perf P95 <= 120ms for short-chat (<=128 tokens) on Dedicated profile, cost delta <= +10% vs current pinned model, QA eval delta <= 3% for top-level intent accuracy. thoughts? 
Mike Patel: those perf numbers look reasonable for Dedicated. For Hosted we should allow slightly higher P95 (<=180ms) but require stronger QA pass for canary (<=2% delta) 
Arjun Singh: can we add a hard fail for hallucination regression on core prompts? e.g., if hallucination rate increases by >1.5x on our smoke suite -> fail 
Selena V: customers will expect a grace period for pin-exceptions. propose: 90 days soft-pin window, automated compatibility shim for 30 days after major model change, and opt-in migration during canary phases 
Kyle Ops: ops notes — need rollout policy config snippet for console. Example: 
```
rollout: {
  canary: 5%,
  duration: 72h,
  monitor: [latency_p95, error_rate, eval_score_delta]
}
``` 
bench-bot: perf-run queued: run suite "onboard-smoke-v2" on aep-4g-dedicated, expected finish 1812345700 
Jana Morales: great — add regression alert thresholds in console: latency +20% sustained for 10m, error_rate >1% for 5m, eval delta > allowed 
Mike Patel: question about pin-exceptions: do we allow permanent pins for enterprise customers? if yes we need billing/contract flag and manual escalation path 
Selena V: yes but only with enterprise contract and readonly pin TTL = indefinite; we need to capture a migration SLA in contract (e.g., 12 months notification for forced retire) 
Arjun Singh: for benchmarks — require both deterministic eval harness and user-sim load test. determinism: same seed, same prompts, verify tokens match for non-stochastic decoders; plus human-review sample for open responses 
Jana Morales: rollout gates checklist (short): 
- Bench harness pass (automated) 
- Canary perf within thresholds 
- Canary eval delta <= allowed 
- Migration docs + customer comm draft 
- Pin exception table updated 
Mike Patel: add a preflight: storage compatibility check (KV cache version), and tokenizer checksum match 
Kyle Ops: operationally: we need a migration rollback playbook and a fast-fallback variant in policy (model_fallback: family-x-quantized) 
Selena V: comms: 2-week early heads-up to affected customers, 72h canary comms, opt-in migration signups during canary, final 30d sunset with links to migration runbook 
Jana Morales: can someone own the migration runbook doc? Arjun? 
Arjun Singh: I can own it. will draft an ops + customer-facing runbook. will include sample k8s manifests for private, API examples, and a checklist for sales handoff. target PR by 1812345695 
bench-bot: onboard-smoke-v2 run complete: perf median 95ms, p95 118ms, eval delta +1.8% (below 3% gate), hallucination rate stable 
Jana Morales: Excellent — that run meets gates for Dedicated. next actions: Arjun to PR runbook, Kyle to add rollout config to console defaults, Selena to draft customer comms, Mike to update pin-exception policy notes for sales. 
Mike Patel: will prepare a short blurb for customers explaining pin TTL options and migration incentives (credits for early migration) 
Selena V: i'll coordinate incentives with growth and legal, cc @sales 
Jana Morales: ok team — keep updates in this thread, planning to merge canary config tomorrow 09:00 PT if all owners sign off :thumbsup:
